ClairIntroText:
I am CLAIR.

The world's best
dragon master.

I can hold my own
against even the

#MON LEAGUE's
ELITE FOUR.

Do you still want
to take me on?

…Fine.
Let's do it!

As a GYM LEADER,
I will use my full

power against any
opponent!
ClairWinText:
I lost?

I don't believe
it. There must be some mistake…
ClairText_GoToDragonsDen:
I won't admit
this.

I may have lost,
but you're still

not ready for the
#MON LEAGUE.

I know. You should
take the dragon user challenge.

Behind this GYM is
a place called DRAGON'S DEN.

There is a small
shrine at its

center.
Go there.

If you can prove
that you've lost

your lazy ideals,
I will recognize

you as a trainer
worthy of a GYM BADGE!
ClairText_TooMuchToExpect:
What's the matter?

Is it too much to
expect of you?
BlackthornGymClairText_YouKeptMeWaiting:
You've kept me
waiting!

Here! Take this!
BlackthornGymClairText_DescribeTM24:
That contains
DRAGONBREATH.

No, it doesn't
have anything to do with my breath.

If you don't want
it, you don't have to take it.
BlackthornGymClairText_BagFull:
What is this? You
don't have room?
BlackthornGymClairText_League:
What's the matter?

Aren't you headed
to the #MON LEAGUE?

Don't you know
where it is?

From here, go to
NEW BARK TOWN.

Then SURF east.
The route there is very tough.

Don't you dare
lose at the #- MON LEAGUE!

If you do, I'll
feel even worse

about having lost
to you!

Give it every-
thing you've got.
CooltrainermPaulSeenText:
Your first battle
against dragons?

I'll show you how
tough they are!
CooltrainermPaulAfterBattleText:
LANCE told you
that he'd like to

see you again?
Not a chance!
CooltrainermMikeSeenText:
My chance of
losing? Not even one percent!
CooltrainermMikeAfterBattleText:
I know my short-
comings now.

Thanks for showing
me!
CooltrainerfLolaSeenText:
Dragons are sacred
#MON.

They are full of
life energy.

If you're not
serious, you won't

be able to beat
them.
CooltrainerfLolaAfterBattleText:
Dragons are weak
against dragon- type moves.
BlackthornGymGuideText:
Yo! CHAMP in
making!

It's been a long
journey, but we

are almost done!
Count on me!

CLAIR uses the
mythical and sac- red dragon-type #MON.

You can't damage
them very easily.

But you know,
they're supposed

to be weak against
ice-type moves.
BlackthornGymGuideWinText:
You were great to
beat CLAIR!

All that's left is
the #MON LEAGUE challenge.

You're on the way
to becoming the #MON CHAMPION!
